findings.message: "Retail buzz?" is anti-predictive (-12pt win delta, n=213) but still appears in decision logic — verify it isn't gating trades.
"Reward:risk worth it?" is anti-predictive (-29pt, n=928). Not gating anything — fine as a model feature, but don't surface it as a quality badge.
"Worth the risk?" is anti-predictive (-28pt, n=941). Not gating anything — fine as a model feature, but don't surface it as a quality badge.

"Leading the market?" is anti-predictive (-12pt, n=937). Not gating anything — fine as a model feature, but don't surface it as a quality badge.
Conviction tiers remain inverted: High 41.7% vs Medium 56.1% win. Any gate keyed on High is selecting the worse cohort.
Conviction referenced only as a pre-model fallback (guarded by a P(win) check) — acceptable.
13 of 71 installed skills are wired into the engine. 22 unused ones look trading-relevant — tested capability going spare.
